policy.identity: Text similarity never confirms one physical building. Promotion records count as published only when their exact Place is in production.
policy.publication: Publish no new shrine or coordinates from this file; first verify site-specific official URL, geographic anchor and custodian, then EN/FR summary and source.
policy.priority: All 64 Essential candidates lead the round-robin geographically balanced queue; then Strong; then Review.
policy.media: One approved correctly identified image per new place is desirable but does not block a map-first physical-site release.
policy.further_enrichment: Only after a broad world rollout: detailed timeline, dated annual programme, devotions, sacred art and cinematic galleries.
